Maya Patel: quick heads-up — PR #2107 has a couple of linter nits (naming/format). I pushed a tiny fixup but would like one more pair of eyes before tonight's merge window. link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2107>

Daniel Green: looking now, will check naming. if it's just snake_case + formatting I'm fine approving after CI.

Priya Singh: I can run the test matrix locally, give me ~10m. also recommend a one-line changelog note: 'refactor: normalize request id naming'

CI Bot: CI started for commit 3f5b2a7 (PR #2107) — running unit + lint + integration suites

Sam Ortiz: quick nit I noticed in kvcache helper: prefer `get_request_id` over `getCtxID` for consistency. small patch suggestion:
```python
- def getCtxID(req):
-     return req.ctx_id
+ def get_request_id(req):
+     return req.request_id
```
should avoid extra callers changes if we add a thin wrapper.

Maya Patel: thanks @Sam — pushed that wrapper and updated callsites, force-pushed as 3f5b2a7 -> 7a9c1d2. also added the changelog line Priya suggested.

CI Bot: CI re-run started for commit 7a9c1d2 (PR #2107)

CI Bot: CI passed — all checks green ✅

Priya Singh: ran the integration locally against latest infra config, everything looks stable. approving now. LGTM :shipit:

Daniel Green: +1 from me, tests + lint clean. merging in next merge slot. tagging @release-manager for visibility.

merge-bot: Merging PR #2107 into main (commit 7a9c1d2). change-type: patch

Maya Patel: merged, thanks everyone — kept this minimal to avoid churn. Will watch deploy metrics over the next hour.

Daniel Green: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
